title: Forward-loop initial configuration
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $Q$ be a state type, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $M$ be a $k$-tape machine with Boolean work symbols and states in $\text{Fin}(n+1)$, and let $c$ be a configuration of that machine on $x$. For an entry state $q\in Q$, the forward-loop configuration has state $q$ when $c$ has a state and is otherwise halted; it preserves the input-head position, the original work tapes and their head positions, and the output. It adds two work tapes with head positions zero: one containing the designated encoding of $M$'s transition table, and one containing the designated summary initialized with no output and the unary encoding of $c$'s state when present.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a $k$-tape machine with Boolean symbols and states in $\text{Fin}(n+1)$
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
caveat: The snippet does not define the transition-table encoding, the summary cells, or the unary state encoding.
